text: 1. Personal Photos: Please upload a standard two-inch color photo with a white or blue background. Do not upload black-and-white photos, artistic photos, or selfies. 2. Personal Information Page of Passport: A scanned copy of the personal information page of a regular passport with a validity period later than January 31, 2026 must be submitted. If the current passport's validity does not meet the requirements, please promptly apply for a new passport. For applicants who are unable to obtain a passport before submitting the application due to objective reasons, please contact our school as soon as possible to confirm the alternative supporting documents. 3. Proof of Highest Education: Applicants who have graduated from high school are requested to upload their "Highest Education Certificate (Graduation Certificate)". For current high school graduates, please upload "Expected Graduation Certificate". The "Expected Graduation Certificate" must be issued by the school and should include the date of enrollment and the expected graduation date; if the "Enrollment Certificate" issued by the school contains the above information, it can be used as an alternative. 4. Transcript of all courses completed during the highest academic level: Please upload the complete transcript from the first year of high school up to the time of application. The transcript must be stamped by the school or signed by the relevant person in charge. When submitting the transcript, it is recommended to also provide a description of the grades (including but not limited to the calculation method of GPA and the grading system for course scores). 5. HSK Certificate: The validity period of the HSK score is two years (counting from the date of the examination). 6. Personal Statement: Please write in Chinese. The content should include your personal study plan, no more than 1000 words. It must be signed by the applicant in person. 7. A recommendation letter: In either Chinese or English format, include the name of the recommender's organization, position, contact information, and have the recommender sign it personally. If the applicant is unable to upload the recommendation letter themselves, please upload the explanatory material in the "Recommendation Letter" section, and have the recommender send the recommendation letter directly to ices@sufe.edu.cn. 8. Criminal Record Certificate: A valid criminal record certificate issued by the local public security authority must be submitted. Generally, it should be a document issued within the past 6 months prior to the application date. 9. Economic guarantee certificate and guarantor's identification document: The economic guarantor must be a natural person with full civil capacity, over 18 years old, and with a stable source of income; the economic guarantor must fill out the "Economic Guarantee Certificate" (economic guarantee certificate.pdf) truthfully and provide a scanned copy of the original passport cover page (for foreigners) or ID card (for Chinese citizens) of the guarantor.
